Specification: This module is a thin Apalache-oriented wrapper around another specification named tcp. It provides type annotations for the constant and variables and instantiates the tcp module so that the original tcp specification remains free of tool-specific annotations. The file itself declares the peer set, three state variables representing per-peer control information, connection state, and network contents, and defines one concrete set of peer string values for configuration purposes. It does not define any transition relation, temporal specification, or fault model in this file.
